tasks.short: Coordinate and anchor news broadcast programmes.

steps.what: Clarify programme priorities, timing and live handoffs with the editorial and production team
Record the running order, approved items, durations and actual handoff cues
inputs: existing approved item and segment records

steps.what: Assemble the cue sheet and calculate programme timings from checked rundown fields
outputs: candidate programme cue sheet and timing totals

steps.what: Approve the final programme cue sheet, timings and production destination
inputs: candidate programme cue sheet and timing totals

steps.what: Commit the approved final cue sheet to the internal production rundown
Brief the programme team and resolve actual live coordination questions
Anchor programme openings, closings and continuity while responding to live changes
outputs: actual programme continuity and coordination observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual programme coordination issues and follow-up notes
inputs: actual programme continuity and coordination observations

steps.what: Save the approved programme coordination note

tasks.design: Configure native newsroom rundown timing and cue-sheet generation ({OTHER}). Keep editorial coordination, exact rundown capture, final review, briefing and live anchoring human. The final cue sheet is approved before its separate internal commit; the post-programme note is separately written/approved before saving. No generated live anchor or automatic editorial change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Timing totals do not establish a workable live handoff or editorial priority.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rundown fields can produce cue sheets and timing totals without repeated copying.
tasks.still_hard: Breaking changes and live programme continuity require editorial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt calmly when a segment fails or the news priority changes on air.
tasks.altitude: Less rundown handling; unchanged live coordination and anchoring.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: newsroom rundown software can assemble cue sheets and timing totals from explicit item fields.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Validate current manual cue-sheet assembly and commits; existing rundown automation earns no new benefit. This task covers whole-programme coordination/opening/closing continuity; individual story presentation has its own task and must not be added again for the same actual action.

Editorial and production owners supply existing approved item records. Journalist captures/checks item_id, sequence, approved_version, duration, cue, next_presenter and live_status in s2 at full time. Missing durations/cues require retained human coordination, not guessed timing.

s3 performs explicit assembly and arithmetic. s4 approves the completed sheet within existing rundown authority before a1. s6 resolves questions; any changed sheet returns to s2/s4 and a new commit, not an uncounted live write.

Journalist produces actual coordination observations in s7 and separately writes/checks the note in s8 before a2. Native newsroom/document functions precede code; commit does not silently send another notification.
research_questions: Does the newsroom system already produce the cue sheet and timing total from the entered rundown?

incremental.description: Check rundown/cue mappings and output versions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete cue sheet and production destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 10 cue assembly, 5 commit and 1 note-save hours minus 1 upkeep = 15. Low halves assembly and keeps commits manual: 5 minus 1 = 4. Live work unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present news stories and introduce recorded or live reporter segments.

steps.what: Read the verified story and check segment content, names and actual live status
Write the story presentation and accurate recorded or live segment introduction
Check and approve the complete script, attribution, segment cues and intended output
Transfer the approved final script to the internal teleprompter output
Present the story and introduce the actual recorded segment or live reporter
Write and approve actual presentation deviations or correction follow-up notes
Save the approved story presentation outcome note

tasks.design: Configure the newsroom systems native approved-script transfer to its teleprompter ({OTHER}). Keep story reading, introduction writing, meaning/attribution checking and live presentation full time. Transfer follows final-script approval; post-presentation notes are separately written/approved before saving. No generated quote, synthetic presenter or automatic on-air correction.
tasks.previous_blocker: A script transfer cannot judge attribution or whether the reporter is actually live.
tasks.enabler_now: Native newsroom/teleprompter integration can remove a repeated copy of an approved final script.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate framing and live delivery require editorial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Avoid introducing an uncertain live connection or allegation as an established fact.
tasks.altitude: Small transfer savings with unchanged story presentation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: integrated newsroom systems can transfer an approved script to a teleprompter without changing its meaning.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual repeated script copy and outcome-note save; current native integration earns no new benefit. This task is individual story/segment presentation, distinct from whole-programme continuity; the same delivered passage must not be rolled up twice.

Editorial sources supply verified materials; production/reporter supplies actual segment/live status. Journalist checks these in s1 and writes the complete script in s2. No machine summarisation or quotation generation is assumed.

s3 checks final words, names, attribution, timing and destination at full time before a1. Integration transfers only that version internally and does not trigger broadcast. Changes require revised approval/transfer; live delivery remains human.
s6 journalist captures actual deviations/follow-up at full time after presentation before a2. Native newsroom/document functions precede code; no uncounted correction send is added.
research_questions: Is the final approved script still copied manually to the teleprompter?

incremental.description: Check script-version and teleprompter destination mappings

approvals.approved_version: s3 final script version and internal teleprompter output

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 5 script-transfer and 1 note-save hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Low halves script-transfer benefit and keeps note save manual: 2.5 minus 0.5 = 2. Reading, writing and presentation unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign stories to reporters and duties to production staff.

steps.what: Establish the actual story priorities, production duties and deadline constraints
inputs: current editorial priorities and production requirements
outputs: clarified story and production assignment needs

steps.what: Review existing staff availability, current assignments and declared relevant coverage experience
inputs: staff-maintained availability and declared coverage information

steps.what: Choose reporters and production staff considering workload, suitability and editorial conflicts
inputs: clarified story and production assignment needs

steps.what: Write and approve complete assignments, scope, deadlines and internal queue destinations
inputs: clarified story and production assignment needs
outputs: approved final story and production assignments

steps.what: Commit approved assignments to the internal newsroom work queue
inputs: approved final story and production assignments

steps.what: Brief assigned staff and clarify reporting scope or production responsibilities
Write and approve actual briefing clarifications and unresolved assignment questions
Save the approved assignment clarification note

tasks.design: Configure a native newsroom assignment/availability view ({OTHER}) using existing records. Keep editorial priorities, staff selection, assignment writing and briefing human. Complete assignments are approved before queue posting; actual briefing clarifications are separately captured/approved before their save. The view does not infer staff performance or choose assignments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability alone does not establish editorial suitability or conflicts.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing assignment and calendar records can be viewed together without repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Workload, sensitive reporting and clear delegation require editorial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Assign a difficult story to someone with suitable context while checking conflicts and support needs.
tasks.altitude: Less staffing lookup and queue transfer; unchanged editorial assignment rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a newsroom system can consolidate existing assignment and availability records and post a completed human-approved assignment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual staffing navigation and assignment posting; existing native views/commits earn no new benefit. No other staff labour is claimed as saved.

Existing assignment editors produce assignment_id, owner and deadline; staff maintain availability and declared relevant coverage through the existing process. No new staff scoring, monitoring, tagging or free availability capture. s2 retains 12 hours per provisional 100 for interpretation and missing-data checks; unavailable source fields use manual lookup.

s3 retains actual choices. s4 writes/checks person, duty/story, scope, deadline and queue at full time before a1. Posting does not silently send a message; staff are briefed in s6. Revised assignments return to the same final review and commit, not an ungated write.
s7 separately captures actual briefing outcomes and unresolved questions at full time before a2. Native newsroom/calendar features precede code; no model allocation or employee assessment.
research_questions: Can the newsroom show existing availability and assignments without asking staff to produce new structured inputs?

incremental.description: Check assignment identity and availability mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 final assignments, owners and queue destinations
s7 final actual briefing clarification note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 8 staffing-navigation, 10 assignment-post and 1 note-save hours minus 1 upkeep = 18. Low halves navigation and keeps commits manual: 4 minus 1 = 3. Selection and briefing unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native newsroom records for coordination while retaining editorial decisions and live presentation.
reach: Help production colleagues distinguish approved scripts, committed assignments and actual programme outcomes.
role.ambitious_version: A journalist who keeps attention on the audience and reporting while reliable native records support the programme team.
